claims.claim: There were zero 5xx and zero non-200 responses across all 9819 requests, on both canary (1.1) and stable (1.0).
The canary carried a real share of traffic: 2476 of 9819 requests, 25.2%.
Over the whole 120 s test the canary p95 was 177 ms versus 94 ms for stable (about 1.9x).
The latency gap is confined to the start of the test: per-30s-window canary/stable p95 goes from 210/93 ms in 0-30s to 94/94 ms in 90-120s.
In the last 60 s of the test the canary served at least 1200 requests and its p95 was within 5 ms of stable overall and on every path, including /checkout.
